name: Publish Studio NPM Package

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'packages/studio/**'
      - 'packages/mesh/**'
      - '.github/workflows/publish-studio-npm.yaml'

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install

      - name: Build packages
        run: bun run build

      - name: Get current version
        id: version
        run: |
          echo "CURRENT_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./packages/studio/package.json').version")" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Check if version already exists
        id: check_version
        run: |
          if npm view @decocms/studio@$CURRENT_VERSION > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "VERSION_EXISTS=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            echo "VERSION_EXISTS=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Bump version if needed
        if: env.VERSION_EXISTS == 'false'
        run: |
          cd packages/studio
          npm version patch --no-git-tag-version
          NEW_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
          echo "NEW_VERSION=$NEW_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          cd ../..
          sed -i "s/\"version\": \"$CURRENT_VERSION\"/\"version\": \"$NEW_VERSION\"/" packages/studio/package.json
          sed -i "s/\"version\": \"$CURRENT_VERSION\"/\"version\": \"$NEW_VERSION\"/" packages/mesh/package.json

      - name: Update mesh dependency version
        if: env.VERSION_EXISTS == 'false'
        run: |
          NEW_VERSION=${{ env.NEW_VERSION }}
          cd packages/studio
          npm install @decocms/mesh@$NEW_VERSION --save
          cd ../..

      - name: Publish to npm
        if: env.VERSION_EXISTS == 'false'
        run: |
          npm publish ./packages/studio --access public
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

      - name: Create Git tag
        if: env.VERSION_EXISTS == 'false'
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config --global user.email 'github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git tag v${{ env.NEW_VERSION }}
          git push origin v${{ env.NEW_VERSION }}

      - name: Update changelog
        if: env.VERSION_EXISTS == 'false'
        run: |
          echo "# Changelog" > CHANGELOG.md
          echo "" >> CHANGELOG.md
          echo "## v${{ env.NEW_VERSION }}" >> CHANGELOG.md
          echo "" >> CHANGELOG.md
          echo "- Auto-published studio package" >> CHANGELOG.md
          echo "" >> CHANGELOG.md
          git add CHANGELOG.md
          git commit -m "Update changelog for v${{ env.NEW_VERSION }}" || echo "No changes to commit"

      - name: Push changelog
        if: env.VERSION_EXISTS == 'false'
        run: |
          git push origin main
